lines: The Last Will and Testament of Nehemiah Hanzer of Indian River Hundred Sussex County State of Delaware:
I Nehemiah Hanzer considering the uncertainty of this Mortal life and being Sick and weak of body but of Sound
mind and memory blessed be Almighty God for the Same do make and publish this my last will and testament in manner
and form following, that is to say: FIRST I give and bequeath to my beloved wife  Jemima Hanzer after all
my Just debts and funeral charges are paid all my Lands whereon I now live together with all my Personal property
Except one bed & furniture hereafter mentioned to her during her natural life and at her death to go and

Decend(?) to my proper heirs at law. ITEM: I give and bequeath unto  Sally Ann Gurley(?) the bed and furniture 	above mentioned  and Excepted out of my wife's legacy and lastly I do hereby appoint my wife Jemima Hanzer Sole 	Executor of this my last will and Testament hereby revoking all former wills by me made. In witness whereof I have 	hereunto Set my hand & Seal this Thirteenth day of September in the year of our Lord one Thousand eight hundred and 	forty Two. -

Signed Sealed published and declared by the Said Nehemiah Hanzer to be his last will and testament in the presence of 	us who at his request and in his presence have Subscribed our names as witnesses thereunto:

The Last Will and Testament of Nehemiah Hanzer of Indian River Hundred Sussex County State of Delaware:
I Nehemiah Hanzer considering the uncertainty of this Mortal life and being Sick and weak of body but of Sound
mind and memory blessed be Almighty God for the Same do make and publish this my last will and testament in manner
and form following, that is to say: FIRST I give and bequeath to my beloved wife  Jemima Hanzer after all
my Just debts and funeral charges are paid all my Lands whereon I now live together with all my Personal property
Except one bed & furniture hereafter mentioned to her during her natural life and at her death to go and
Decend(?) to my proper heirs at law. ITEM: I give and bequeath unto  Sally Ann Gurley(?) the bed and furniture 	above mentioned  and Excepted out of my wife's legacy and lastly I do hereby appoint my wife Jemima Hanzer Sole 	Executor of this my last will and Testament hereby revoking all former wills by me made.
